t: What PBFT Internals Is All About
title: What PBFT Internals Is All About
description: Byzantine fault tolerance: consensus when nodes can lie (Castro-Liskov).. This database covers PBFT Internals with full records: definitions, key facts, working procedures, and runnable demo programs, arranged on a teaching ladder from Foundations to Advanced. Consensus is agreement despite failures; it's the core of distributed systems.
definition: PBFT Internals — Byzantine fault tolerance: consensus when nodes can lie (Castro-Liskov).
key_points: Consensus is agreement despite failures; it's the core of distributed systems.
Raft is understandable consensus; use it.
Paxos is the original; harder but equivalent.
Majority quorums are the mechanism; overlap ensures safety.
how_it_works: Choose a proven implementation (etcd, Consul); don't write your own.
Deploy 3 or 5 nodes across failure domains.
Configure timeouts for your network's latency.
Enable snapshotting and bound log growth.
Test leader failure; measure election time.
Test partition; verify safety holds.
Monitor commit latency and leader stability.
Document the recovery procedure.
